verdict.rationale: A managed Redis-compatible key-value store is a fair capability for a cloud platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions Redis, a key-value store, caching or job queues. Managed Postgres is a different data service, and running arbitrary VMs is only a building block, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues
